title: Approvals
description: Reviews pinned to an exact version of a file, document or milestone.

emptyView.awaiting_me: Nothing is waiting for your review

emptyHint: Reviews start from a file version, a document or a milestone.
createdFromItems: To request a review, open the file, document or milestone and ask for approval there.
subjectMissing: The reviewed item is no longer available.
newerRoundNotice: A newer version replaced this round. Round {round} is the live one.
pinnedToVersion: Pinned to version {version}. Later uploads don't change what is reviewed here.
notLatest: The file is now at v{latest}
noPreview: This file type has no preview. Open the file to download it.
youDecided: You've recorded your decision. The round stays open until the rule is met.
closedRound: This round is closed; decisions can't change.
roundsHint: Each new version starts a round of its own.

decide.title: Your decision

ruleHint.all: Every reviewer must approve before this is done.
ruleHint.any: The first approval closes this review.

decide.commentPlaceholderChanges: Be specific, so the team can act on it.
decide.commentRequired: Explain what needs to change so the team can act on it.

manage.title: Manage
manage.remindHint: {count, plural, one {# reviewer hasn't decided} other {# reviewers haven't decided}}. One reminder a day.
manage.reassignBody: Hand this review to someone else. Only reviewers who haven't decided can be replaced.
manage.cancelBody: Reviewers stop being asked. Decisions already recorded stay in the history.
